name: storybridge-functions
description: Cloud Functions for storybridge-eb71e — the Resend-backed mail pipeline (contact notifications, subscriber welcome, newsletter test/send) and server-side reCAPTCHA verification for the public contact form. A standalone npm project, deliberately outside the pnpm workspace: Cloud Functions' build servers expect their own lockfile in this directory.

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
